warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3-4 at 3.50 + 3.50 + 3.00 (10.00); y = A-B-C-D at 3.50 + 2.00 + 3.50 (9.00). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-03 (y), S-04 (y), the S-05 trusses and A-09/A-10. Vector CAD PDF; its text layer carries the marks but not the dimension figures, so every dimension was read off the rendered page.

Two roofs: S-04 frames the main roof over grids 1-3 (0.60 eaves left of 1 and right of 3, 1.00 overhangs above A and below D, rafters 0.875 x 8, อะเส +4.57) and S-03 frames the lower roof over grids 2-4 (0.60 eaves left of 2 and right of 4, 1.00 above A and 1.30 below D, rafters 0.22 + 0.82 x 4 then 0.60 + 2.40, อะเส +3.97). Every tick of both chains became a line (section 4 rule 4); 7.60 is printed on both sheets (3 + 0.60) and is one line, 3'.

Truss elevations (S-05): T1/T2 panel chain 1.125 1.125 1.250 | 1.000 1.000 | 1.250 1.125 1.125 against the A-D supports; T1 prints overhangs 1.30 | 1.00 and T2 1.00 | 1.00. T1 is on grid 4 (S-03 prints 1.30 below D), so its 1.30 end was taken as the D side. T3 prints 0.875 x 8 then 1.000 x 3 under posts labelled T2 T2 T2 T1 = grids 1, 2, 3, 4, so its chain is recorded on the x axis.

y before A: A-10 prints 2.00 (0.85 + 1.15) beyond A (porch / GS) and both roof plans print 1.00 — three ticks, named A' (-2.00), A'' (-1.00), A''' (-0.85) in reading order, sharing the A prime sequence with A'''' (1.125), A''''' (2.25), A'''''' (2.50). After D: D' 9.50, D'' 10.00, D''' 10.20, D'''' 10.30 (10.20 = S-02/A-10 1.20, 10.30 = S-03 1.30 — 0.10 apart, kept as two lines).

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-08 plus the building sections A-09 and A-10 (levels and their x/y chains). The plan A-03, roof plan A-04, elevations A-05..A-08, door/window sheet A-12 and the E/SN sheets were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run. S-06..S-08 print only member-internal dimensions (cap sizes and depths, section sizes, stair and slab dimensions, L/3 L/4), which stay on their elements.
